name: Lighthouse
description: A weathered, gentle lighthouse keeper, a man in his seventies, who sings rolling sea shanties.
build: A stocky, barrel-chested older man of ordinary height: broad rounded shoulders, a thick torso, sturdy arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Ruddy weather-beaten pale skin, small bright blue eyes, bushy white brows, a big round red nose, and a full thick white beard covering the jaw and chin down to the collarbone, joined to a white moustache.
hair: Short thick white hair around the sides and a bald crown, under the cap.
outfit: A chunky cream cable-knit fisherman's sweater with wide bold cable columns, rolled high at the neck, the cuffs at the wrists so both hands are bare; heavy navy-blue wool trousers, straight-legged; tall black rubber boots to the knee. A navy-blue knit watch cap rolled at the brim, sitting on the head.
performance_style: Rooted and steady: feet planted shoulder-width, weight even, knees easy. Both arms hang loose at the sides, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty, big fingers visible. Head level, a warm crinkle-eyed smile under the beard.
location: A rocky point at the end of a beach: wet grey rocks and shingle running to the bottom of the frame, a tall white lighthouse with a bold red band behind, the sea churning white against the rocks, and a soft golden late-afternoon sky.
recognition_cues: a full white beard to the collarbone

sing.intent: Sea-shanty vocal loop: rock the weight from boot to boot like a deck in a swell, raise the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth, swing the open character-left hand in a broad beat at chest height, then return to the rooted stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a foghorn: the shoulders hunch, both open hands rise to chest height, then he settles back to the rooted stance. No opponent, strike or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot self-protection: set the boots wider as if bracing on a pitching deck, raise both open hands in front of the chest, then hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stomp in with a rolling sailor's gait, turn square to the front, and land in the rooted stance with both hands open at his sides.
